answer: Invitation quota trees cap each identity at three invites, and any birth cluster whose attestations come from one subnet forfeits 50% of its standing. A farm of 1,000 faces needs 334 paths across distinct ranges, each invitee landing onyx-tier work before the branch counts, which is a comet of real registrations for one operator. The open question is what happens to the quota when an invitee goes dormant on the thread mid-epoch.
